author: crow
title: Commission story scene art for My Undying Hero
content:
I’d like to apologize for not being clearer in my last post. I should have specified that I’m currently only looking to commission artists who have read My Undying Hero, enjoy the story, and are interested in drawing a specific scene from it.

As much as I’d love to commission random scenes and artwork right now, what I’m really looking for at the moment is art that can be directly tied to scenes that actually happen within the story.

Sorry again for any confusion, and thank you to everyone who reached out! Contact: DM @Crowbetalking
